sample_multichannel_sentences: sample multichannel sentences from a pre-trained language model using beam search
generate_multichannel_hypotheses: generate token hypotheses for multichannel input sentences with configurable beam size
encode_multichannel_sentence: encode a multichannel sentence dictionary into tokenized tensors per channel
decode_multichannel_tokens: decode multichannel token tensors back into human-readable strings per channel
build_batches_for_inference: build batched iterators from tokenized multichannel sentences for inference
